gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.

gaps.lead: A long, dry summer caused the famine.
gaps.sentence: The famine ___ a long, dry summer.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = B results from A (note the direction).

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: It's very unlikely that Martin will win the 100 metres, as he's out of training.
gaps.sentence: Martin has almost ___ the 100 metres, as he's out of training.
gaps.explanation: 'It's very unlikely he will win' becomes 'he has almost no chance of winning'.

gaps.lead: The concert was cancelled because hardly anybody came.
gaps.sentence: The concert was cancelled ___ people came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.
